description: Set a user's ban state in this app: "none" (lift), "banned" (the app shows the ban message and blocks play; Neblla refuses everything but their messages to you), "terminated" (blocks them for good: their device is sealed so the app no longer opens there, and they are disconnected), "community_muted" (can play, and can still REPORT entries, but cannot publish, rate or review). Takes effect live. WARNING: "terminated" seals the user's device, and lifting it with "none" does not unseal a device that is already sealed (the user has to clear the site's data) The other two are fully reversible with "none". This tool keeps no reason, no note and no history: if the developer needs a record of why someone was sanctioned, neblla_send_communication or a community case note can hold it.
name: neblla_set_ban_status
title: Set ban status
